title: Loaded Chocolate Chip Blondies
changes_from_base: Packed with semisweet chocolate chips (and optional nuts) in a melted-butter brown sugar batter.
summary: A big tray of brown sugar blondies packed with semisweet chocolate chips and optional nuts.
equipment: 23 x 33 cm metal baking tin, lined with a baking-paper sling

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Turn the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and line the big rectangular tin with an overhanging sling.

steps.title: Melt
steps.text: Melt the butter in a saucepan, add the brown sugar and stir until smooth. Tip into a bowl and leave until lukewarm.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Beat in the eggs, vanilla and salt, then stir in the flour and baking powder. Fold in the chocolate chips and nuts.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread in the tin and bake 25-30 min, until golden brown and the centre no longer looks wet.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool fully in the tin; cut into 24.

tips: Let the butter and sugar cool to lukewarm before adding the eggs.
Leave out the nuts for a nut-free bar, but check chocolate labels.
They are done when the middle no longer looks wet.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
